transport_conventions.external_links: Absolute external links are preserved; Stepik may add rel/target attributes on read-back.
transport_conventions.markdown_assets: Learner-facing Markdown dependencies are rendered into the owning Stepik step.
transport_conventions.binary_assets: Binary learner assets use confirmed URL or guarded Stepik attachment/image materialization routes.

scope_note: Platform rendering conventions only. This file contains no lesson identity, content baseline, write authority or special lesson class. Lesson provenance lives exclusively in machine state/history.
